contract.input_promise: kappa_2(A)<=n^2, c=2 input precision; identical inputs for all modes
contract.accuracy: Relative Euclidean error <=n^-2/10; exact squared-fraction acceptance
contract.timing: Three rotated warm repeats; full solve including normalization, selection, backend check, rounding, lifting and recovery. Reference and checks excluded.
contract.memory: Separate tracemalloc call per policy excludes native allocations; RSS is entire-process high-water including references/instrumentation, not per-mode memory.
contract.evidence: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE: finite checks, no optimality/scaling or asymptotic speedup claim
